notes: Research, Discovery & Knowledge UI: hidden world properties and experiment outcomes now exist separately from what citizens actually know. Surveys and experiments create persistent discovery records; inconclusive results are retained; learned verification processes can emerge from validated discoveries. Communication now tracks provenance-backed information receipts and unverified face-to-face claims, Memory exposes bounded per-citizen/location knowledge, and the UI adds a simpler Home plus dedicated Citizens, Locations, and Records views. Unknown resources/properties stay absent until discovered. Visitor busy/talk status now identifies the real counterpart, and citizen sheets show authoritative cargo capacity, experiments, learned processes, equipment, projects, and bounded knowledge.
